title: Gonur Depe (Gonur Tepe)
summary: Gonur Depe is a Bronze Age settlement mound in the Karakum Desert of south-eastern Turkmenistan, on the ancient Murghab delta. Dated to 2300–1500 BC, it is one of the largest and best-studied sites of the Bactria-Margiana Archaeological Complex, with a palace-temple complex and burial grounds, and it is ringed by more than twenty small settlements.

uncertainty.note: Both opened pages give 2300–1500 BC for the occupation. Other scholars date the urban phase differently, but no such view was read on an opened page.
